verdict.rationale: Lambda documents its own S3-compatible adapter that lets standard tools like rclone and s5cmd copy files to and from its filesystems, which gives a first-party way to move stored datasets out. It also states there are no long-term commitments, which eases leaving. However, nothing documents exporting all account data (instance disks, account metadata, usage history) or a formal offboarding or export process. Missing for 10: a documented full-account data export, export of instance disks/images and account metadata in open formats, an offboarding/deletion process, and independent corroboration that egress works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: This adapter allows you to use S3-compatible tools like rclone and s5cmd to copy files to and from your filesystems and perform common file operations.
A filesystem is a high-capacity regional file store you can attach to your instance to store datasets and back up system state.
